ayahs.1: When the earth is shaken with its final earthquake—
ayahs.2: and throws out its burdens—everything buried, hidden, and stored will surface;
ayahs.3: and people cry, 'What is happening to the earth?'—
ayahs.4: that Day it will report its news—
ayahs.5: because your Lord inspired it to speak.
ayahs.6: That Day people will return in groups to be shown the results of what they did—no more crowds to hide in.
ayahs.7: Whoever did an atom's weight of good will see it—no good erased as 'too small.'
ayahs.8: And whoever did an atom's weight of harm will see it—no cruelty dismissed as 'minor.'
